messages:
oleg: Putting a short follow-up from the design huddle: propose a "Quorum Routing" variant for finalization to limit cross-region surprises. jotting tradeoffs here.
mira: quick summary pls?
oleg: idea: keep provisional writes local, but finalization for a billing-partition requires quorum of region-forwarders (>=2 of 3) before we seal. reduces single-region bias for late arrivals.
dan: interesting. that adds cross-region latency though. we care about SLA for small tenants.
oleg: yep. plan is adaptive: low-traffic partitions use local-fast finalizer; high-traffic or high-risk partitions require quorum. threshold based on daily token-rate + tenant tier.
mira: how do we implement quorum? durable markers in kafka + commit_key?
oleg: commit pattern: each region writes a signed provisional-mark to an agreed staging topic with region_id and sequence. a router waits for quorum for (fingerprint, window) then runs deterministic merge and emits canonical. if quorum not reached within timeout, fallback to local-only finalizer and emit a mismatch-audit.
dan: what's the timeout?
oleg: default 2m for quasi-quorum; adaptive per SLA. We surface provisional immediately; finalization waits. Fallback path must be auditable.
mira: storage cost for provenance? we shouldn't keep full payloads hot.
oleg: raw provisional blobs -> cold S3 90d. each region also writes a compact provenance envelope to audit-db (fingerprint, input_ids, blob_hashes, origin_region, recv_ts). TTL 30d. audit entries link to raw blob hashes.
dan: replay story if merge logic changes?
oleg: deterministic reprocess supported: run merge over raw blobs for specified partition and window, emit replacement canonical segment + tombstone manifest. consumers apply patch. We'll keep a replay-manifest with checksums + reprocess-version.
ops-bot: NOTE: reprocesses > 1h will auto-escalate to oncall.
mira: how to guarantee emitter idempotency across regions?
oleg: use commit_key = "{tenant}|{fingerprint}|{window_start}|{finalizer_v}". Regions write candidate finalization records; router dedups by commit_key. Candidate records carry region-signatures so audit can show who contributed.
dan: edge-case: clock skews between regions could flip ordering.
oleg: we normalize times by ingest counter + monotonic arrival sequence per region. final decision uses (region_seq, region_id) tie-breaker. all of these recorded in audit manifest.
mira: API UX: will customers see provisional vs finalized?
oleg: yes, API returns provisional with provenance_id immediately. Finalized value and any adjustment deltas are emitted later. Console shows lineage and a small marker if quorum-fallback occurred.
dan: ops/metrics?
oleg: dashboards: part_pending_quorum, avg_quorum_wait, fallback_rate, provisional_vs_final_delta_pct, reprocess_backlog. Alerts when fallback_rate > 0.5% or delta_pct > 1%.
mira: rollout?
oleg: staged: (1) shadow mode single-region router (emit canonical to audit topic only, no consumer switch) - 2w; (2) multi-region quorum in shadow with analytics teams - 1w; (3) canary tenants - 1w; (4) billing canary + 48-72h parallel-run - 1w. Total ~5w. owners: routing infra (dan), audit-store (mira), finalizer logic (oleg).
dan: lgtm. please add a short state diagram in RFC and include commit_key examples + WAL pattern.
oleg: will do. opening infra tickets tomorrow. ops-bot: TODO created: quorum-shadow-run scheduled.
billing-bot: quick ask - how do we reconcile money adjustments for customers? need clear audit trail and billing delta emails.
oleg: agreed. finalization delta events will include audit_links and human-reason. billing svc will render delta emails using audit manifest. we'll add a policy doc for user-facing adjustments.
mira: +1
dan: +1
